title: Couple Getaway to the Land of the Rising Sun
alt: Sunrise over the Tokyo skyline with Mount Fuji beyond
transport: Bullet train, private transfers and guided day tours

stops.name: Tokyo
stops.subtitle: Tokyo to Disneyland and Mount Fuji
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast · Super deluxe room · 4★ · Four star hotel in Shinjuku, a short walk from the station

activities.name: Tokyo sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided day from the LOVE statue in Shinjuku through Meiji shrine, the Imperial Palace gardens and the temple lanes of Asakusa.

activities.name: Tokyo Disneyland
activities.description: A full day at Tokyo Disneyland with your admission tickets included, so you can be at the gates when the park opens.

activities.name: Mount Fuji, Hakone and Gotemba outlets
activities.match: Trip to Mt Fuji 5th Station, Hakone & Gotemba Outlets
activities.description: The fifth station on Mount Fuji, Lake Ashi in Hakone and a shopping stop at the Gotemba outlets on the way back.

program.name: Tokyo
program.description: Four nights in Shinjuku with a guided city day, a day at Disneyland and the mountain with the Gotemba outlets.

stops.name: Osaka
stops.subtitle: Osaka to Kyoto, Nara and Arashiyama
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Simple hotel opposite Shin-Osaka station, handy for the trains

activities.name: Sumo show experience
activities.description: A demonstration bout with retired wrestlers who explain the rituals, let you into the ring and serve the stew they live on.

activities.name: Osaka walking tour
activities.description: Half a day on foot through Dotonbori, the Kuromon market and the lanes around Shinsekai with a guide who knows where to eat.

activities.name: Universal Studios Japan
activities.description: A full day at Universal Studios Japan with tickets included, home to Super Nintendo World and the Harry Potter area.

activities.name: Kyoto, Nara and Arashiyama
activities.description: Kinkaku-ji and the deer park at Nara, then the bamboo grove at Arashiyama with a ride on the open sided Sagano scenic train.

program.name: Osaka
program.description: Four nights in Osaka with a sumo show, a walking tour, Universal Studios Japan and a day through Kyoto, Nara and Arashiyama.

day_titles.5: On to Osaka and the sumo ring

1: Arrival at Narita or Haneda and transfer to your hotel
Check in at your Shinjuku hotel
Rest of the day free at your own pace
Optional: the Tokyo Metropolitan Building viewing decks, free of charge
2: Breakfast, then a guided day through the city
Meiji shrine and the Imperial Palace gardens
Asakusa and the Senso-ji temple lanes
3: Early breakfast, then across to Tokyo Disneyland
Admission tickets included for the full day
4: Breakfast, then out of the city towards Mount Fuji
The fifth station on the mountain, weather permitting
Lake Ashi and the Hakone viewpoints
A shopping stop at the Gotemba outlets
5: Breakfast and check out, then the bullet train to Osaka
A sumo show with retired wrestlers
The stew the wrestlers live on, served afterwards
6: Breakfast, then a half day walking tour of Osaka
Dotonbori and the Kuromon market stalls
The lanes around Shinsekai with your guide
7: Early breakfast, then across to Universal Studios Japan
Tickets included for the full day
Super Nintendo World and the Harry Potter area
8: Breakfast, then a full day out with your guide
Kinkaku-ji, the golden pavilion, on its pond
The deer park and Todai-ji temple in Nara
The bamboo grove and Sagano scenic train at Arashiyama
9: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Kansai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Six included experiences, two hotels and no early checkouts in between. Nine days that feel longer than they are.
expert.tip: Leave the Kyoto day until late in the trip, as we have. By then you will know how the trains work and the day runs itself.

summary: Nine days for two between Tokyo and Osaka: four nights in Shinjuku with a city day, Tokyo Disneyland and the Mount Fuji fifth station, then four in Osaka with a sumo show, a walking tour, Universal Studios and a day through Kyoto, Nara and Arashiyama.
included: Included: 8 nights with daily breakfast; bullet train from Tokyo to Osaka; private airport transfers; Tokyo sightseeing tour; Tokyo Disneyland tickets; Mount Fuji fifth station with Hakone and the Gotemba outlets; Osaka sumo show; Osaka walking tour; Universal Studios Japan tickets; Kyoto and Nara tour with Arashiyama and the Sagano train.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
